title: anthyllis vulneraria subproles maritima
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subproles maritima, commonly known as Maritime Kidney Vetch or Sea Kidney Vetch, is a sub-species of the Anthyllis vulneraria plant, which is a type of flowering legume native to the coastal regions of Europe and North Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to soothe and calm irritated skin, making it a popular remedy for wounds, burns, and eczema, thanks to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The health benefits of Anthyllis vulneraria subproles maritima include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and providing antioxidant protection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
